note: Banca Transilvania's notice: a lender reports to the Biroul de Credit a payment at least 30 days late, after warning the borrower at least 15 days before; the bureau keeps the data four years from its last update (BRD's notice says the same four years).

sources.title: Banca Transilvania, Nota de informare privind prelucrarea datelor cu caracter personal in contextul incheierii/executarii unui contract de credit
sources.said: datele dumneavoastra personale in cazul in care veti inregistra intarzieri la plata creditului de cel putin 30 de zile, dupa instiintarea dvs prealabila in acest sens cu cel putin 15 zile inainte de data raportarii. ... se stocheaza in evidentele acestei institutii timp de 4 ani de la data actualizarii.

sources.title: BRD, Informare privind prelucrarea datelor in Sistemul Biroului de Credit (24.07.2024)
sources.said: Datele cu caracter personal sunt stocate la Biroul de Credit si dezvaluite Participantilor timp de 4 ani de la data actualizarii
